title: Fundamental Limits of Coherent Imaging in The Presence of Atmospheric Turbulence
abstract: arXiv:2611.06784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the fundamental limits of jointly estimating the signal amplitude and the atmospheric phase distortion in complex-valued multi-look coherent imaging, where the measurements are corrupted by multiplicative speckle and additive Gaussian noise, all looks share a known Gaussian sensing matrix, and both parameters belong to structured classes. By analyzing a constrained maximum likelihood estimator, we establish an upper bound on the joint minimax risk that holds uniformly over the admissible parameter classes, while oracle reductions and Fano-type arguments yield worst-case lower bounds over the admissible parameter classes. These results quantify the effects of structural complexity, signal and measurement dimensions, the number of looks, and the noise level, and establish matching minimax rates in several settings, with a remaining gap for phase estimation at low noise when the measurement dimension exceeds the signal dimension.

translated_title: 大气湍流存在下相干成像的基本极限
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在复值多视角相干成像中联合估计信号幅度与大气相位畸变的基本极限，其中测量受到乘性散斑噪声和加性高斯噪声的污染，所有视角共享一个已知的高斯感知矩阵，且两个参数均属于结构化类别。通过分析约束最大似然估计器，我们建立了在可容许参数类别上一致成立的联合极小极大风险上界，同时借助oracle约化和Fano型论证得到了可容许参数类别上的最坏情况下的下界。这些结果量化了结构复杂度、信号与测量维度、视角数量以及噪声水平的影响，并在若干设定中建立了匹配的极小极大速率，但当测量维度超过信号维度时，低噪声条件下的相位估计仍存在理论差距。
tldr: 该论文研究了大气湍流下复值多视角相干成像中信号幅度与大气相位畸变联合估计的基本极限，通过建立匹配的极小极大风险上界和下界，量化了结构复杂度、维度、视角数量和噪声水平对估计性能的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the fundamental minimax limits for jointly estimating signal amplitude and atmospheric phase distortion in multi-look coherent imaging under atmospheric turbulence, providing matching upper and lower bounds that quantify the effects of structural complexity, dimensions, number of looks, and noise level.
